text: THE WEBSITE HOME PAGE CARRIES NOTHING THE DESIGN DOES NOT. Two sections the Figma reference never drew are gone, on the instruction that the page match the design: the announcements ticker under the banner carousel, and the task band beneath it with the page headline, the search field and five task tiles. Both were added for a reason and both reasons are recorded rather than lost — the ticker answered DBIM 3.0 §A.4.1 iii, which asks a departmental home page for an announcements ticker, and the task band answered register issue NAV-01, that the live page offers a citizen no starting task; the divergences are written up in docs/website-redesign/home-audit-2026-09-22.md. The announcements themselves were the same eight updates What's New already lists, and the search is in the masthead on every page, so nothing is now unreachable. The page's only h1 came with the task band, and a page without one fails GIGW and WCAG whatever it looks like, so the h1 is now a screen-reader heading above the carousel naming the Department, and the tab title starts with it (issue SEO-06). The page opens as the design does: masthead, SAMAVESH band, banner carousel, the Prime Minister's quote, About the Department.
